title: German Braised Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful German-style beef stew made with tender beef, aromatic vegetables, and a rich red wine sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion, carrot, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the red wine to the pot and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Return the beef to the pot and add the beef broth, stew, and flour.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise the stew in the preheated oven for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
